title: Sopli
description: This is a joke mod "Sopli", which just sends many "ТЮЛЮЛЮ", but with cooldown obviously.
body: **Sopli is a joke mod designed for one purpose: sending the "ТЮЛЮЛЮ" message (actually there is 42 "ТЮЛЮЛЮ").** ## ⚙️ Features & Usage - Command: Simply type /sopli to send this messsage. - Cooldown (anti-spam): 30 seconds between uses. ## 📅 Planned Features - English language ## 🛠 How to Report Issues Please report any issues via the [Issues Tab](https://github.com/ks51s/sopli/issues) on our GitHub repository. Please provide logs if the features _(command/cooldown or both)_ doesn't work.
